protocol.baseline: 9/17 strong local ZAPS implementation, not author-code parity or the paper 1000-image mean.
protocol.scope: Fixed FFHQ IDs00000-00009 x4 tasks x model-coordinate sigma .025/.05/.10 x3 arms. One seed/image; all cells retained.
protocol.arms: ZAPS_LOCAL_300 is unmodified local ZAPS. CLOSED_SCALAR_300 is the A71 noise-corrected native-q ray. CLOSED_DIAG_300 starts from that scalar and makes one exact steepest-descent update in the native db4 coefficient support for the same frozen linear observation target.
protocol.objective: omega=(1-Msigma^2/||r||^2)+; minimize .5||PH(delta/sqrt(alpha_t))-omega Pr||^2. Scalar is the nested ray solution; diagonal changes direction and length. This is a current-state frozen response proxy, not an actual next-denoiser response.
protocol.equal_nfe: Every complete reconstruction must have exactly300 denoiser forwards,10 optimizer backwards,0 input VJP,0 input JVP and the identical30x10 grid. H/Ht and db4 counts are separate.
protocol.pairing: Same image, y, operator, initial/final RNG and learned-prefix entry per arm. Independent from-seed complete runs; no cached learned policy, GT action, best epoch or output selection.
protocol.tasks: SR4 empirical historical bicubic guidance; Gaussian61/sigma3 zero boundary; frozen DPS motion61/intensity.5; random70% missing. Inpainting statistics use observed RGB coordinates.
protocol.decision: For each task/noise and candidate-vs-reference: mean PSNR>=+.1dB, >=7/10 PSNR wins, SSIM nondecrease, LPIPS nonincrease and paired gates. Report all failures/tradeoffs.
protocol.qualitative: Before outcomes, IDs00001/00004/00008 fixed for panels. Show GT, observation, all three outputs; no best/worst selection.
protocol.limits: Small ten-image local confirmation. No actual-response, posterior, author-reproduction, acceleration, universal-transfer or curvature claim.
